Who is this phone for?

Manara is two apps: one for you, one for your child.

👨‍👩‍👧

Mine, I'm the parent

Manara Parents: from your own phone, set the rules, get the alerts and see the activity on your child's phone.

It asks for no permission on your phone and doesn't manage it.

Open the console Android app (test) Coming to the Play Store. On an iPhone or a computer, the console opens in the browser.
🧒

My child's

Manara goes on the child's phone. It always shows that the phone is managed.

  1. Create your parent account in the console.
  2. Choose Add a phone: the console guides you step by step (about 15 minutes).
Start in the console Read the guide Android only. Works on a phone already in use, without resetting it.

Only for your own minor child's phone. Manara never reads messages, never sees photos and never listens to calls.
